newsitem.title: PERU: Lima municipality to issue $150 million in bonds.
newsitem.headline: Lima municipality to issue $150 million in bonds.

text.p: The municipality of Lima will issue $150 million in bonds to finance urban projects, the Peruvian capital's mayor, Alberto Andrade, said Tuesday.

"We have launched here in Barcelona something that we have been working on privately -- an imminent issue of $150 million of bonds to finance part of the works we have," Andrade said in an interview via telephone from Spain with local radio station.

Andrade, who was attending the InterAmerican Development Bank's annual conference, said such an issue was possible due to Peru's improving economy and the completion of the Brady Plan to restructure its foreign commercial debt.
He told Radioprogramas del Peru the bonds would be offered both locally and abroad, but did not give any more details.
